title: Non-Consecutive Occurrences
scenario: Find numbers that appear at least 3 times total in the table, but NEVER appear consecutively.
hint: Find all numbers appearing 3+ times, then subtract those that appear consecutively.
correctQuery: SELECT num FROM logs GROUP BY num HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT num FROM logs l1 JOIN logs l2 ON l1.id = l2.id - 1 AND l1.num = l2.num;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, num VARCHAR); INSERT INTO logs VALUES (1, '1'), (3, '1'), (5, '1');
